table.name: museum
table.purpose: Lookup table of museums; one row per museum with its staff size and opening year.

Museum_ID.name: Museum ID
Museum_ID.description: Primary key identifying each museum; referenced by visit.Museum_ID.

Name.name: Museum name
Name.description: Full name of the museum (e.g. 'Capital Plaza Museum').

Num_of_Staff.name: Number of staff
Num_of_Staff.description: Count of staff members employed at the museum (12–62).

Open_Year.name: Opening year
Open_Year.description: Year the museum opened (2000–2012), stored as text.

table.name: visit
table.purpose: Fact table of museum visits: tickets bought and money spent by a visitor at a museum.

Museum_ID.name: Museum ID
Museum_ID.description: Foreign key to museum.Museum_ID identifying the visited museum.

Num_of_Ticket.name: Number of tickets
Num_of_Ticket.description: Number of tickets purchased in the visit (2–24).

Total_spent.name: Total spent
Total_spent.description: Total amount of money spent on the visit, in dollars (19.98–320.44).

visitor_ID.name: Visitor ID
visitor_ID.description: Foreign key to visitor.ID identifying the visitor who made the visit. (A statistical join to museum.Museum_ID also matched, but the visitor.ID join is the semantically correct one.)

table.name: visitor
table.purpose: Lookup table of visitors: each row is a person with age and membership level.

Age.name: Age
Age.description: Age of the visitor in years (25–56).

ID.name: Visitor ID
ID.description: Primary key identifying the visitor; referenced by visit.visitor_ID.

Level_of_membership.name: Level of membership
Level_of_membership.description: Numeric membership level of the visitor (1–8), higher presumably meaning a higher tier. The statistical join to museum.Museum_ID is coincidental, not a real reference.

Name.name: Visitor name
Name.description: Full name of the visitor (e.g. 'Arjen Robben').
